title: Summarizer uptake: term stabilization, SURFACE canonization and uptake windows
description: These claims hold that a term stabilizes in the summarizer through repeated identical use across deposits, and that frequency of appearance tracks summarizer confidence in attribution. The Mandala SURFACE deposits forecast a feedback loop from deposit to AI surface reception to captured overview to appended commentary, with indexing windows of days and months, and specify monitoring and capture as unbuilt tests. Further claims from the SPXI, Gravity Well and Living Architecture Lab deposits set out scoring before structured data and basin tracking for named entities.
